product_metadata.title: Essentially Yours Memorial Floral Vase with Foam Inserts (Green, 2 Pack) | Vases with Ground Stakes for Outdoor Use, Fresh or Artificial Flowers
features: The EY vase set is great for creating elegant floral arrangements for any event. The included stake keeps the vase upright so that your flowers stay long lasting, and the included foam inserts are perfect for customizing your arrangements.

The EY vase set is great for creating elegant floral arrangements for any event. The included stake keeps the vase upright so that your flowers stay long lasting, and the included foam inserts are perfect for customizing your arrangements.

Set of 2 vases with included foam inserts. Vases are made from durable, weather-resistant polypropylene. Each vase measures 7 inches tall, and an additional 3 inches with the included stake. Opening is around 3 inches.
Perfect for memorials, but also for celebratory outdoor events such as weddings, and parties.
Green color blends in nicely with your grass or shrubs for an unobtrusive look.
